nodes.label: Chart Roadmap — Beating TradingView for the Active Trader
nodes.rationale: Don't out-feature TradingView on breadth; win on fastest multi-timeframe read + tightest chart→trade loop with table-stakes charting good enough that a trader never leaves. Build order deliberately 0→1→3→4→5→2 (drawing tools last, per user).

nodes.label: Indicator Strategy: bucket, don't transpile
nodes.rationale: No PineScript transpiler or JS Pine runtime (weeks of work, correctness risk, most indicators aren't custom Pine). Bucket A = indicatorts library wiring (~10 min each); Bucket B = hand-port golden-master gated; Bucket C = already built. Library-backed does NOT mean TradingView-identical — golden master catches divergence (VWAP anchoring, Keltner basis, Stochastic smoothing).

nodes.label: Multi-Indicator Stack Engine (1B): activeIndicatorIds[], namespaced instanceKey::plotId
nodes.rationale: Lifts the structural limit of exactly one active indicator; series namespaced instanceKey::plotId fixes Bollinger/Keltner basis collisions; oscillator panes rebuilt only on signature change (per-tick just pushes data) to survive pane-index shifts; stack persists to localStorage and share URL (?ind=, URL wins).

nodes.label: Decoupled SVG Drawing Layer (7 tools, per-symbol persistence)
nodes.rationale: Built as a decoupled SVG overlay over the chart rather than threading state through the chart's fragile canvas pointer machine; drawings positioned in chart-time/price space so they stick on pan/zoom; keyed by symbol in localStorage.

nodes.label: MTF Confluence Ribbon (time-aligned per-TF signal heatmap)
nodes.rationale: The differentiator TradingView structurally lacks: one row per timeframe, each a time-aligned heatmap over the selected chart window; colorblind-safe (color + glyph + label); click a row to switch TF.

nodes.label: Timeframe-Group Divergence Callouts (lower 1m–15m vs higher 1h–1d bias)
Chart→Trade One Surface (right-click orders, draggable TP/SL updates position)
Bar Replay (cut-point selector, scrub, speeds, bookmarks, isolated session)
nodes.rationale: Replay state slices the candle array to the play index so indicators replay too; exits on TF/symbol change.

nodes.label: Price Alerts (model + reactive store, dashed price lines, cross-fire notification)
Renko Box-Size Methods (Traditional / ATR / Percentage)
nodes.rationale: Chart types deliberately limited to Candlestick/Heikin-Ashi/Renko — Line/Area/Baseline/Bars/Hollow intentionally not wanted because they'd require re-attaching order-overlay/FX/marker primitives bound to the candle series.
